name: A-share daily, back-adjusted
adjustment: Back-adjusted (hfq): the earliest prices keep their quoted values and later prices are scaled up for every dividend and split, so returns are total returns but prices differ from historical quotes

name: A-share daily, unadjusted
adjustment: Unadjusted: prices gap on ex-dividend / ex-rights dates

name: A-share intraday, unadjusted
time: 1h: four bars per day starting 09:30, 10:30, 13:00 and 14:00; 4h: the provider's 240-minute bar, one per trading day (09:30-15:00). datetime is the provider's end time minus the period; close_time is the provider's end time

name: China futures main continuous, ratio back-adjusted
source: Exchange daily data per contract (SHFE, INE, DCE, CZCE, CFFEX) via AKShare
adjustment: Main contract = the contract with the largest open interest that never rolls back to an earlier expiry; a roll decided at day t's close takes effect after t and earlier history is scaled by close_new(t) / close_old(t). Returns equal those of a roller; earlier prices are not the prices that traded then
time: trading date (night sessions belong to the next trading day)

name: China futures continuous (Sina XX0), unadjusted
adjustment: Sina's continuous contract without roll adjustment (roll gaps remain); roll rule and volume convention follow Sina and are not audited

name: China futures intraday (Sina continuous), unadjusted
adjustment: Sina continuous contract, no roll adjustment
time: Bars follow the provider's end times: each covers the 1 or 4 trading hours before its end and may span the lunch break, the night session and the next morning. datetime is the nominal end minus the period; use close_time

name: US stock daily, total-return adjusted
adjustment: Adjusted for splits and cash dividends (Yahoo adjusted-close method); returns are total returns

name: US stock 15-minute (Dukascopy stock CFD), adjusted
adjustment: Back-adjusted with Yahoo's split and dividend events (same method as Yahoo's adjusted close); returns are total returns
time: regular session (09:30-16:00 New York), bar start time
volume_unit: Dukascopy CFD volume, not exchange volume

name: Yahoo daily
adjustment: Yahoo's regular prices: split-adjusted, not dividend-adjusted
volume_unit: shares; US dollars for BTC-USD; SSE volume is 0 in early years and inconsistent, avoid it

name: US stock hourly, regular session
adjustment: Yahoo's regular prices: split-adjusted, not dividend-adjusted
time: 09:30-16:00 New York time; the last bar of a day is the half hour 15:30-16:00, shorter on early-close days. close_time is the bar end

name: ETF proxy of a US future, daily, adjusted
adjustment: Prices are the adjusted prices of the ETF named in the proxy column of files.csv, not futures prices; no roll gaps, short-borrow costs not included

name: Futures / index 15-minute (Dukascopy CFD)
adjustment: CFD quotes, unadjusted; an intraday proxy of the future or index, whose price level differs from the futures price
volume_unit: Dukascopy CFD volume, not exchange volume

name: Global futures front-month continuous daily
adjustment: Yahoo's front-month continuous contract without roll adjustment; roll gaps remain and returns are not holding returns

name: Forex daily
time: trading date (days start at midnight London time)
